name: 404 Human Error
problem: Packaging artwork approval is currently a manual and time-consuming process involving multiple stakeholders. Human reviewers may overlook minor errors such as incorrect ingredients, nutrition information, allergen statements, barcode, product claims, or regulatory labeling. These mistakes can lead to production delays, product recalls, customer complaints, and compliance risks.
whyTrack: AI-powered agent that automatically reviews packaging artwork against approved specifications and regulatory requirements. It detects inconsistencies, missing information, and labeling errors while significantly reducing review time, improving accuracy, and accelerating the artwork approval process.
